blocks.name: CoreScript

coreScriptExpressions.value: The user's adapted luminance level is simulated by closing the gap between
adapted luminance and current luminance by 2% every frame, based on a
30 fps rate. This is not an accurate model of human adaptation, which can
take longer than half an hour.

coreScriptExpressions.raw: FLOAT fNewAdaptation = fAdaptedLum + (fCurrentLum - fAdaptedLum) * ( 1 - pow( 0.98f, 30 * fElapsedTime.x));

coreScriptFlow.content: FLOAT fNewAdaptation = fAdaptedLum + (fCurrentLum - fAdaptedLum) * ( 1 - pow( 0.98f, 30 * fElapsedTime.x))
